_comment: Byte-lock for ToyBosonFermionGenerator. The GENERATOR is the artifact; no dataset is
stored. These vectors pin a handful of seeds so a change in generator behaviour shows up
as a readable diff (.claude/rules/no-binary-in-proof-lineage.md: verification artifacts are
Each vector is `count` samples emitted by `generate seed flips count`, concatenated as
`ToyBosonFermionGenerator.toHex`: one nibble of true Cl(4) blade mask, two nibbles of the
observed 8-bit word, one nibble of label (0 = bosonic / even grade, 1 = fermionic / odd).
`meteredBits` is the entropy measured at the membrane per sample: 4 bits to draw the blade
plus 3 bits per flip operation (log2 8, exact). It is part of the lock because an unmetered
crossing is an unmeasured quantity, and the degradation curve is plotted against it.
The seed-sensitivity vectors exist because a generator that IGNORED its seed would pass a
same-seed-twice check trivially. Both halves are asserted.
encoding: hex, 4 chars per sample: blade(1) observed(2) label(1)
